sources.title: Apple: Configuring a custom keyboard interface
sources.finding: iOS may provide a system dictation button with custom keyboards. hasDictationKey=true suppresses/disables it; leave false to permit it.

sources.title: Apple: hasDictationKey
sources.finding: The property indicates an own dictation key; it is not an API to start system dictation from an arbitrary custom control.

sources.title: Apple: open access for custom keyboards
sources.finding: Full Access does not grant direct microphone capture to the custom extension.

sources.title: Wispr Flow iPhone setup
sources.finding: Provider documents containing-app opening/automatic return and a confirmation on first return. Not an example of cold zero-transition custom recording.
